brief.topic: The Gentle Rhythm Between Two Steady Notes

s01: Two steady notes can make a sound that seems to breathe.
Here are two nearby pitches, played together.
Listen for the slow swelling.
Neither note is pulsing on its own.
Their vibrations keep sliding into agreement, then out again.
When they agree, their pushes add.
When they oppose each other, those pushes partly cancel.
We have slowed these two vibrations so you can follow their alignment.
The sound itself vibrates hundreds of times each second.
One note is two hundred and twenty hertz.
The other is two hundred and twenty-one.
It gains one whole vibration every second.
So their alignment returns once each second.
That difference, one hertz, is the rate of the beats.
Move the second note closer, to two hundred and twenty point five.
Now the swelling takes twice as long.
The beat rate is the difference between the two frequencies.
This is one way musicians can hear a small tuning mismatch.
As the notes meet, the beating slows away.
A gentle rhythm can come from the relationship between two steady things.

scenes.narration:
Two steady notes can make a sound that seems to breathe. Here are two nearby pitches, played together. Listen for the slow swelling.

Neither note is pulsing on its own. Their vibrations keep sliding into agreement, then out again. When they agree, their pushes add. When they oppose each other, those pushes partly cancel.

We have slowed these two vibrations so you can follow their alignment. The sound itself vibrates hundreds of times each second. One note is two hundred and twenty hertz. The other is two hundred and twenty-one. It gains one whole vibration every second.

So their alignment returns once each second. That difference, one hertz, is the rate of the beats. Move the second note closer, to two hundred and twenty point five. Now the swelling takes twice as long.

The beat rate is the difference between the two frequencies. This is one way musicians can hear a small tuning mismatch. As the notes meet, the beating slows away. A gentle rhythm can come from the relationship between two steady things.
